info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Securities Position Keeping Validation-spec
info.description: The Securities Position Validation API enables users to validate the integrity of securities positions within banking account management. This service is essential for ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial transactions related to securities. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial services providers that require reliable position validation for regulatory or operational purposes. By submitting data through this API, users can initiate validations that safeguard against discrepancies in securities holdings.
